required_work.requirement: A separately reviewed native service-is-ready operation bound to the exact selected type/identity/principal/resource/effective QoS, plus actual host/module/epoch association. Existing graph/open does not prove readiness. wait_for_service currently refuses95 before clock or request.
Actual native availability/duration waits and ERROR-severity logging are still missing. Preserve exact source; never replace it with the separately named explicit-ready migration lesson.
The selected official server ignores its header and gets a null opaque shared_ptr. Native requester GUID/sequence/header inspection needs a genuine dedicated protocol; no ticket reinterpretation.

Current move-only future wraps actual service_submit IDs/events, exact completion errors/flags and locally retained ownership. General std::future/shared_future/wait/wait_until/promise and native signed sequence/binary ABI are not implemented.
Actual official callback overloads, typed shared-future/shared-request callbacks and pruning APIs need complete group lease and bounded ownership semantics, not a synchronous callback shim.

One exact external step permits one bounded pass; existing granted Clock drives existing timers. No native waitset, hidden blocking/sleep, thread pool, broad timeout overload or QoS service-discovery loop is claimed.

Only exact AddTwoInts type and the declared official-default-service-profile token are mapped. Native effective QoS/identity must be separately proved; broad QoS/options/callback-group allocators/GenericClient/GenericService remain required.
Parameters, graph/remapping/context options, action APIs, composition and all remaining official public headers require their own full source, protocol, ownership and genuine execution work.
This C++ increment does not replace the required ROS SDKs/tests for the other languages, all vendor interfaces/models/versions or complete official test matrices.

separate_availability_source_design: Memory owns an independent optional real Host/Gateway availability protocol; this cohort neither imports that mutable source nor predicts its behavior/pins.
